purpose: Shared-age recorded-diagnosis transport stress test, including SCH, with source-fitted preprocessing.
population: Retain every original row and original label, including the 304 WHU patients without linked raw JSON. No exclusions by source availability or diagnosis label.
feature: One predictor: age in years, at earliest dated recorded observation in SCH/WHU and admission in MIMIC.
age_rule: Use certified source-rebuilt demographics, not the age/sex columns of copied prediction CSVs. Cap age above 91 in every centre before modelling, consistently with the retained MIMIC de-identification handling. The MIMIC age is admission calendar year minus birth calendar year, capped above at 91; Chinese age is the recorded numeric age at the earliest timestamp. These definitions are close but not identical exact-age measurements.
sex_exclusion: Chinese codes 1/2 lack an authenticated male/female mapping; no sex transfer or assumed recoding is performed.
source_unit: SCH and WHU patients; MIMIC admissions, with all original repeated admissions retained.
labels: Original centre-specific stored diagnostic labels, not a common incident clinical endpoint.
source_training: Each centre trains on its entire original source population. MIMIC admits each original admission as a training row. Target labels are unavailable to fit_source; there is no target retraining, scaling, imputation, calibration or threshold selection.

pipeline: StandardScaler fitted only to source age
SplineTransformer fitted only to source age

bootstrap.unit: target patient; all of a sampled patient's admissions receive the same multiplicity

model_selection: Both models and hyperparameters fixed before any target performance is calculated. No choice by target AUC.
scope_limits: Does not complete the four SCH common-laboratory transfers or authenticate SCH assay identity/units/scale.
Does not make native outcomes, observation windows or patient/admission units equivalent.
Does not establish prospective prediction, clinical adjudication, complete negative capture or exclude all indirect leakage in the original biomarker models.
Does not provide independent source-centre validation: only external target scores are evaluated.
Differences from historical multivariable AUCs cannot be attributed to any single feature family.
